cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with symbols coming from above.
Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble. There's no limit to the
 number of possible tumbles.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
This is the SCATTER symbol.
 6 - 2000 SCATTER symbol is present on all reels.
 5 - 300 SCATTER pays on any position in the base game.
 4 - 40 It does not explode as part of tumbles and remains on the
 screen until the end of all tumbles resulted from the same spin.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
FREE SPINS RULES
 The FREE SPINS FEATURE is awarded when 4 or more SCATTER symbols hit anywhere on the screen.
 The round starts with 10 free spins.
The FREE SPINS round starts with the locked row fully locked. Every tumble that happens during the FREE SPINS
 round counts towards the unlocks. Once unlocked, positions remain like that until the end of the round.
During the FREE SPINS round, whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol hits, the MULTIPLIER value gets added to the total
 multiplier. For the whole duration of the round, the total multiplier is used to multiply any win.
 Whenever 3 or more SCATTER symbols hit during the FREE SPINS ROUND, 5 additional free spins are awarded.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.
  MAX WIN
 The maximum win amount is limited to 10,000x bet. If the total win of a round reaches 10,000x
 bet the round immediately ends, win is awarded and all remaining features are forfeited.

multipliers.name: MULTIPLIER
multipliers.behavior:
These are the multiplier symbols. They are present on all reels and can hit randomly during
 spins and tumbles in both base game and FREE SPINS.
Whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol hits, it takes a random multiplier value of 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 15x, 20x,
 25x, 30x, 40x, 50x, 60x, 80x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 300x, 400x, 500x or 1000x.
 When the tumbling sequence ends, the values of all MULTIPLIER symbols on the screen are added
 together and the total win of the sequence is multiplied by the final value.

features.name: Tumble Feature
features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with symbols coming from above.
Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble. There's no limit to the
 number of possible tumbles.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

 The game has a locked row of symbols on top of the basic 6x5 grid. Subsequent tumbles resulted from the
 same spin can unlock positions one by one, from left to right. Once unlocked, the new positions contain
 symbols and are part of the game grid until the end of all tumbles resulted from the current spin.
 Unlocks happen as follows:
 After the first tumble the position on top of reel 1 unlocks.
 After 3 more tumbles the position on reel 2 unlocks.
 After 6 more tumbles the position on reel 3 unlocks.
 After 9 more tumbles the position on reel 4 unlocks.
 After 12 more tumbles the position on reel 5 unlocks.
 After 15 more tumbles the position on reel 6 unlocks.

 spins and tumbles in both base game and FREE SPINS.
Whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol hits, it takes a random multiplier value of 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 15x, 20x,
 25x, 30x, 40x, 50x, 60x, 80x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 300x, 400x, 500x or 1000x.
 When the tumbling sequence ends, the values of all MULTIPLIER symbols on the screen are added
 together and the total win of the sequence is multiplied by the final value.

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, the game behaves differently.
 The possible values are:
 Bet multiplier 25x - the chance to win the FREE SPINS round naturally is higher. More SCATTER symbols are
 present on the reels. The BUY FREE SPINS feature is disabled.
 Bet multiplier 20x - Normal play.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
 When buying the FREE SPINS round, on the triggering spin 4, 5 or 6 SCATTERS can hit randomly.
